typical_delay.note: Cold Archive FAQ: restore 'can last up to 48 hours'; SLA 48 h, often shorter. The FAQ text largely describes the bucket-level v1 service; the per-object v2 class may differ.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Prices page footnote: minimum storage duration 4,320 hours (180 days); early deletion is charged as (minimum hours - hours stored) x hourly price.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the prices page, FAQ or technical limitations page checked.

notes: Only in Paris eu-west-par (endpoints guide). Written with DEEP_ARCHIVE. Restored objects are stored in the Standard class and billed for the restore period (prices page). Object Lock is not available for Cold Archive (FAQ).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No allowance needed: outgoing external traffic is listed as free for every Object Storage class (see price_per_gb).

egress.free_allowance_scope: Egress to the internet is free; no allowance.

price.note: Prices page, Object Storage - One Zone and Multi Zone tables: 'Ingoing / Outgoing external traffic: Free' for every class.

notes: Internal traffic (to and from OVHcloud servers) is also free. The FAQ says traffic or public bandwidth limitations may exist per service or region, and bandwidth is shared with a maximum of 1 Gbps per connection.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use volume limit is stated on the prices page or FAQ; the FAQ only says 'Some traffic/public bandwidth limitations may exist for a given OVHcloud service and/or a given region'.

free_tier.note: No permanent free tier found. The product page mentions a 'Public Cloud Free Trial' voucher for a first Public Cloud project; its amount and terms were not verified.

object_lock.note: Guide 'Managing object immutability with Object Lock (WORM)'; FAQ: not available for the Cold Archive class.

s3_endpoints.note: Endpoints guide: unique 'io' endpoint https://s3.<region>.io.cloud.ovh.net for all classes; bucket endpoint https://<bucket_name>.s3.<region>.io.cloud.ovh.net is described as virtual-host style. Legacy 'perf' endpoint (default class High Performance) is kept only for backward compatibility.

notes: All prices are normalised from per GiB to per GB (divide by 1.073741824); each note quotes the original per-GiB figure from the prices page.
Billing granularity is 1 GiB per hour; monthly figures on the prices page are approximate (730 h).
Local Zone and legacy Swift offers are not modelled.
